Subject: Redwood Inference demo — proposed time (Mar 10 9:00 AM PDT)

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro — excited to get a demo scheduled. Our engineering and product teams in NZ + AU can join, and we were hoping to lock in a 30–40 minute walkthrough of Redwood's hosted & dedicated options.

Proposed time:
- Fri Mar 10, 2028 — 9:00 AM PDT (Redwood timezone)

I've attached an .ics for the proposed slot and a short deck with our high-level goals. Please confirm if that works for your team or suggest an alternate window.

Attendees we expect from GreenShift:
- Olivia Chen (Product)
- Sam Park (SRE)
- 2x Engineers (Auckland)

Attachments: Redwood_GreenShift_Demo.ics, presentation_green_shift_deck.pdf

Cheers,
Olivia Chen
Product Lead, GreenShift AI
olivia@greenshift.ai

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenshift.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference demo — proposed time (Mar 10 9:00 AM PDT)

Hi Olivia — thanks for sending this over and for the deck. Quick heads-up: several folks on the GreenShift side are in NZ/AU and daylight saving changes are coming through this weekend in different regions. If I'm reading the time conversions right, 9:00 AM PDT would be early on Sat morning for your Auckland team (~02:00–03:00 local).

We definitely want the right people in the room. Could you let us know whether the Auckland engineers need a morning local time? If so, we can propose a few slots that are kinder to APAC, or offer a recording option if only a couple people can’t make the live demo.

Possible alternatives from our side (all durations 30–40m):
- Option A: Fri Mar 10, 4:00 PM PDT — Sat Mar 11, 9:00 AM NZDT (works for NZ morning)
- Option B: Fri Mar 10, 8:00 AM PDT — Fri Mar 10, 1:00 PM EDT (US-friendly; not good for NZ)
- Option C: Fri Mar 10, 11:00 PM PDT — Sat Mar 11, 6:00 PM NZDT (late PDT but evening NZ)

Can you confirm which people are must-haves and which can watch a recording? Once we hear back we’ll update the invite and push an adjusted .ics.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenshift.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@greenshift.ai>, demo-coordinator@greenshift.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 20:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference demo — proposed time (Mar 10 9:00 AM PDT)

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the note and for flagging the DST risk. Sorry — we should have double-checked. Our Auckland engineers do need a morning slot local-time if possible (they prefer 08:30–11:00 NZDT). The PMs can take notes / watch a recording if it moves outside that window.

Given that, Option A (4:00 PM PDT / 9:00 AM NZDT) looks best for the engineering attendees. A couple constraints: Sam needs the session to end by 10:00 NZDT because of a customer standup; Olivia (me) can be flexible.

Please go ahead and send a revised invite for Option A and include any pre-demo questionnaire or connection details we should review.

Best,
Olivia
